project_name: GeoPulse - AI-Based Dynamic Traffic Routing System
audit_scope: Comprehensive Dataset and Project Folder Audit

travel_time_validation.recommendation: DO NOT use stored travel-time columns for Dijkstra routing. Compute edge costs deterministically from validated edge length and predicted speed.

graph_feasibility_details.conclusion: A directed road graph G=(V,E) cannot be constructed from the tabular traffic data alone. Connecting centroid coordinates produces physically invalid topologies. The original Bhubaneswar OSM GraphML must be restored.

ml_feasibility_details.task: Next-hour speed prediction: X(t) -> speed(t+1) in km/h
limitations: Duration spans 16.4 days total (13.4 clean days), preventing seasonal or annual generalization claims.
67.7% ceiling effect (currentSpeed == freeFlowSpeed) leads to bounded distribution.
Single-step prediction does not prove multi-step recursive autoregressive stability.

data_leakage_risks: Target speed at t+1 must never be present in feature set at t.
Same-timestamp currentTravelTime, speed_ratio, and congestion_level derive from currentSpeed(t) and must be lagged before predicting speed(t+1).
The CSV file sets is_congested=False on missing rows, creating an artificial negative label if unobserved rows are not filtered.
The CSV calendar features (hour_of_day, day_of_week) are based on UTC, lagging local diurnal patterns by 5.5 hours; local features must be derived in Asia/Kolkata.
freeFlowSpeed varies over time for 671 segments; it must only be used if verified to be an ex-ante time-of-day profile.
synthetic_data_reason: Real observed traffic data (246,399 rows) is fully sufficient for training the next-hour speed prediction model and running real-world traffic replay. Held-out test sets contain genuine peak-hour congestion dips and 25,374 real roadClosure events. Synthetic data is ONLY optional for simulating a controlled dynamic incident perturbation during rerouting demonstrations, and if used, must be generated as a separate labelled runtime overlay.
recommended_preprocessing: Adopt traffic_structured_v1.parquet as the single canonical processed dataset.
Filter all ML modeling to is_observed == True.
Exclude the front-loaded missing period (Jan 1 - Jan 3) and use the 322-hour clean window (Jan 4 - Jan 17).
Compute local calendar features strictly in Asia/Kolkata (IST).
Construct strict backward-looking lags (t, t-1, t-2, t-3, t-6, t-12, t-24) per segment_id.
Discard stored currentTravelTime and freeFlowTravelTime columns for routing cost calculation.
Do NOT clip or alter observed speeds (ranges 1 to 54 km/h are valid urban speeds).
recommended_next_step: Restore and version the exact Bhubaneswar OSM road graph (bhubaneswar_drive.graphml) and resolve physical edge mapping and connectivity before implementing Dijkstra routing.
